messages:
alex.sales: Hey team — onboarding POC for AcmeCorp stuck. SAML SSO passes but users not being created via SCIM, and Dedicated pool tokens not issued. I get 403 on token create.

mira.se: Which provisioning flow? Hosted API keys or Dedicated pool service account?

alex.sales: Trying Dedicated. Customer expects SCIM to auto-create service account user in group "redwood-poc". IdP sends transient NameID and 'mail' attribute.

samir.engineering: Transient NameID = problem. We require stable userName/email mapping. Can you paste SAML attrs (NameID, email, eduPersonPrincipalName)? Also paste SCIM sync logs.

alex.sales: Snippet coming in — paste below: 
```
SAML Assertion attributes:
NameID: _transient_12345
mail: engineer@acme.io
eduPersonPrincipalName: engineer@acme.io
```

devops: SCIM error from our side shows:
```
POST /scim/v2/Users 400 {"detail":"attribute 'userName' required"}
```

mira.se: Looks like SCIM expects 'userName' to match our username. IdP is not populating userName; it's using transient NameID. Need mapping in IdP to set userName = mail.

alex.sales: Customer says Okta template didn't set userName. They used Email in saml only. Can we accept 'mail' as fallback?

samir.engineering: We can, but must adjust onboarding validation for Dedicated so we accept email->userName fallback. For now quick fix: manual user create via Console or add SCIM mapping to set userName from mail. Julia, can ops create service account?

julia.ops: I can create the service account and attach to Dedicated pool; will need customer consent to share username/email. Also for Private/VPC they need IP allowlist — remind them to provide CIDR.

alex.sales: I created service account manually (acme-poc-svc). Confirmed token minted and Dedicated pool shows 10 RPS. Customer testing in progress.

devops: Filed follow-up ticket to add SCIM mapping docs + console validation. Ticket RED-983.

mira.se: Recap: root cause = IdP produced transient NameID, missing userName for SCIM. Workarounds: set userName=email in IdP or manual invite. Action items: docs update, onboarding validation, automate fallback if mail present.

alex.sales: Thanks all — marking POC as unblocked. I'll follow up with customer onboarding doc and confirm dedicated metrics next week. :thumbsup:

idp-bot: SAML assertion received for acmecorp at 1812345680
